title: Automated Logistics Compliance Extraction
business: Global logistics firms managing thousands of unstructured shipping manifests and customs declarations.
problem: Manual data entry from scanned, non-standardized PDF documents leads to high operational costs and frequent compliance errors.
solution: Utilize LlamaIndex with LlamaParse to perform agentic OCR on complex documents, converting them into structured Markdown for indexing and automated retrieval by an LLM-powered agent.
steps: Install the LlamaIndex framework and LlamaCloud SDK.
Upload raw PDF manifests to LlamaParse for agentic OCR processing.
Convert parsed Markdown pages into LlamaIndex Document objects.
Initialize a VectorStoreIndex to enable semantic search over the parsed data.
Wrap the index as a tool for an autonomous agent to query specific compliance fields.
outcome: Reduced manual processing time and improved accuracy in identifying compliance discrepancies across diverse document formats.
limitation: The reliance on cloud-based parsing for complex documents introduces a latency trade-off; verify performance by monitoring the parsing duration of high-page-count manifests.

diagram.title: Document Ingestion and Retrieval Pipeline
diagram.description: The flow from raw document input to agentic query response.

code.content:
from llama_cloud import LlamaCloud
from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, Document

# Initialize client for parsing
client = LlamaCloud()
# Parse complex PDF into markdown
result = client.parsing.parse(file_id="manifest_001", tier="agentic")
documents = [Document(text=p.markdown) for p in result.markdown.pages]
# Create index for agent retrieval
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)
code.explanation: This code demonstrates the ingestion pipeline for Automated Logistics Compliance Extraction by parsing raw PDFs into structured documents and indexing them for the agent.
